parameters.query:
with candidate as materialized (
  select
    content_id,
    title,
    category,
    confidence_label,
    target_duration_seconds,
    source_payload_json
  from content_items
  where status = 'idea_approved'
  order by created_at asc
  limit 1
), claim as (
  update content_items ci
  set status = 'scripting',
      updated_at = now()
  where ci.content_id = (select content_id from candidate)
    and ci.status = 'idea_approved'
  returning ci.content_id
)
select
  c.content_id,
  c.title,
  c.category,
  c.confidence_label,
  c.target_duration_seconds,
  c.source_payload_json
from candidate c
join claim cl on cl.content_id = c.content_id;

insert into scripts (
  content_id,
  hook_option_1,
  hook_option_2,
  hook_option_3,
  selected_hook,
  narration_script,
  short_script,
  caption_draft,
  cta_line,
  onscreen_text_json,
  generation_model,
  raw_response_json,
  approved_by_human
)
values (
  '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid,
  '{{$json.hook_option_1_sql}}',
  '{{$json.hook_option_2_sql}}',
  '{{$json.hook_option_3_sql}}',
  '{{$json.selected_hook_sql}}',
  '{{$json.narration_script_sql}}',
  '{{$json.short_script_sql}}',
  '{{$json.caption_draft_sql}}',
  '{{$json.cta_line_sql}}',
  '{{$json.onscreen_text_json_sql}}'::jsonb,
  '{{$json.generation_model_sql}}',
  '{{$json.raw_response_json_sql}}'::jsonb,
  false
)
on conflict (content_id) do update set
  hook_option_1 = excluded.hook_option_1,
  hook_option_2 = excluded.hook_option_2,
  hook_option_3 = excluded.hook_option_3,
  selected_hook = excluded.selected_hook,
  narration_script = excluded.narration_script,
  short_script = excluded.short_script,
  caption_draft = excluded.caption_draft,
  cta_line = excluded.cta_line,
  onscreen_text_json = excluded.onscreen_text_json,
  generation_model = excluded.generation_model,
  raw_response_json = excluded.raw_response_json,
  generated_at = now()
returning content_id, selected_hook, generation_model, generated_at;

update content_items
set status = 'script_complete',
    confidence_label = '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare SQL Values"].json["confidence_label_sql"]}}',
    updated_at = now()
where content_id = '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid
returning content_id, status, confidence_label, updated_at;
